note: TBox for the vault knowledge graph. Deliberately OWL 2 RL-shaped (forward-chaining rules, no tableaux reasoning) — see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-12-vault-knowledge-graph-design.md sec. 3.

Skill.label: Skill
Skill.definition: A skills/<id>/SKILL.md folder: the unit of agent instruction.

ExpertProfile.label: Expert profile
ExpertProfile.definition: A templated scientific expert-thinking persona imported from scientific-agents. Distinct from Skill: it wraps no tool and produces no artifact, so it must not be scored by tool/artifact relations.

Tool.label: Tool
Tool.definition: Underlying software, library, or service that a Skill wraps (Scanpy, samtools, IQ-TREE).

Artifact.label: Artifact
Artifact.definition: A typed data object exchanged between skills. Identified, never a bare string — the token 'rds' is ambiguous between artifact:r-serialized-data and service:aws-rds.

Capability.label: Capability
Capability.definition: A verb-phrase of what gets done, cross-cutting domains (batch correction, variant calling).
Capability.population: curated + gated LLM proposal; NOT frequency-mined (measured: n-gram mining returns template boilerplate)

Domain.label: Domain
Domain.definition: One of the 32 vault domains, as a SKOS concept scheme.

Recipe.label: Recipe
Recipe.definition: A named hyperedge: an ordered set of Skills achieving a goal. The vault's highest-value asset for set-completion.

references.definition: Skill body names another skill. Untyped association; the base connectivity layer.

touches.definition: Skill mentions an artifact type, direction unknown. High recall, deliberately undirected.

consumes.definition: Skill takes this artifact as input.

in_domain.note: was 1:1 in the original build script, which was already lossy

alternative_to.guard: NEVER asserted from embedding similarity or an unreviewed LLM suggestion alone (KR: no owl:equivalentClass from Text2Onto without curator review)

rules.head: chains_to(A,B)
rules.body: produces(A,x) AND consumes(B,x) AND A != B

rules.head: co_occurs_with(A,B)
rules.body: has_step(r,A) AND has_step(r,B) AND A != B

rules.head: chains_to(A,B)
rules.body: has_step(r,A,i) AND has_step(r,B,j) AND j = i+1
rules.note: recipe step order is human-authored direction — the only direction source that is both cheap and trustworthy today

rules.head: alternative_to(A,B)
rules.body: implements(A,c) AND implements(B,c) AND wraps(A,t1) AND wraps(B,t2) AND t1 != t2 AND jaccard(sig(A),sig(B)) >= 0.5
rules.note: disabled until Capability and Tool are populated; firing it on a sparse TBox would assert near-equivalence on no evidence

ASSERTED.definition: Curated by a human in an assertions file or a recipe note.

EXTRACTED.definition: Deterministic parse of SKILL.md. No model involved.

INFERRED.definition: Materialised by a rule from other edges.

extraction_policy.note: Two-tier name matching. Measured: matching skill names anywhere in the body takes orphans 48.1% -> 1.4%, but skill ids that are common words (github df=42%, workflow df=41%, start df=37%) contaminate every neighbourhood. IDF separates them without a hand-maintained blocklist.
extraction_policy.tier1: df <= 2% of corpus: match anywhere in the first 8KB of the body
extraction_policy.tier2: df > 2%: match ONLY in high-precision contexts (backticked, skills/<id> path, markdown link, frontmatter) — recovers recall without prose noise

python_checks.note: These document the checks in src/kg/validate.ts, which CI runs via `skillquarium validate`. ontology/shapes.ttl is retained as a declarative statement of the same constraints; nothing executes it since the RDF layer was dropped. Ids are deliberately P-prefixed: an earlier version numbered both catalogues S1..Sn, and they drifted into meaning different things under the same id.

checks.gate: orphan_rate must not regress; baseline 48.1%, target < 5%
checks.note: no SHACL equivalent: this is a corpus health metric, not a per-node constraint

checks.constraint: provenance in provenance_levels AND justification minCount 1
every lexicon term maps to exactly one id, or is flagged ambiguous
has_step targets resolve to existing Skills
